slides.title: The label that matters
slides.caption: Whole beans can reasonably count as fresh for about three weeks after roasting. Wherever you shop, look for a roast date.

slides.title: Buy where you can see the roast date
slides.body: Grocery store for ease, café for advice, online roaster for choice. Check the date every time.
